system.summary: Sensitive words of romanised telegrams put into two-digit kana numbered serially 00-67 through the syllabary by vowel rows, voiced kana after the plain one, written in groups of five.
system.notes: ヲ written オ (53); ハ written 08 or 14. Values 68-99 are not in the table; 91 and 69 occur in C09122806100 (91 twice where the translation has ニ就キ / ニ就テ). 30 table values are filled from the rule, unattested. Not the grid of the General Staff's outgoing drafts (army1901) nor the 1902-04 table (army1902).

prior_solution.where: Every telegram has its contemporary translation in the same file, and in some the recipient wrote the kana beside the digits; no earlier reconstruction of the table found (contributor's PRIOR_CHECK.en.md, 10 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Contributed: Harumi-Matsuba directed the work; Claude Fable 5.2 transcribed and rebuilt the table; OpenAI Codex made a blind second transcription; Claude Sonnet checked prior work. No human checked the transcriptions. The project re-implemented the table, re-decoded every run and re-ran a shuffled-table control; images not reachable here.
models: OpenAI Codex gpt-6-astra, reasoning effort high (contributor)

solution.what: army1902 (issue #58): C09122806100 tried with the 1902-04 table, periodic additives and iroha/gojuon shifts; nothing fits.
Contributor: digits of seven 1901 telegrams transcribed from the JACAR images (Claude Fable 5.2); blind second transcription by Codex, 123/135 digits.

Contributor: five telegrams (C09122805800, 805900, 806000, 801000, 724200) aligned with their filed translations; 38 values attested, arranged as the syllabary by vowel rows with voiced kana after the plain one, numbered from 00; the other 30 filled by the rule.

Contributor: applied to C09122796200 (モ, ト, グ fixed by the rule beforehand) and C09122806100 (ンチワ, フクム, テンシヨク; 69 and 91 off the table): 16/16 kana against the translations for the two together (10 + ンチワ, フクム); 0 of 1,000 random permutations as good.

Project: decode.py from the stated table; 77 of 80 pairs give the kana of the filed translations (the three misses are the off-table 91, 91, 69); on the two test telegrams 21 kana agree against max 5 for 1,000 shuffled tables (seed 1901, control_out.txt).
Project: JACAR images could not be fetched from this session (proxy); digits not checked against the images.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The table was rebuilt from five telegrams against the contemporary translations filed with them, then tested on two more.
outcome.fraction_read_source: decode_out.txt, digit pairs: 77 of 80 agree with the filed translations; the three open pairs are 91, 91 and 69 in C09122806100.

validation.notes: Japanese kana plaintext, no Japanese model in lang/; a shuffled-table control against the filed translations was run instead (21 against max 5 of 1,000).

gaps.detail: outside the table; 91 stands where the translation has ニ就キ/ニ就テ, apparently a word code; no code list found

gaps.item: C09122724200 three digits re-read with the table in hand

outcome.notes: Outside the LLM paper's scope (Japanese; contributed). The telegrams were read at the time; what is new is the table. AI transcriptions only.

texts.label: 2 Mar 1901, Taku
texts.summary: Fukushima at Taku to Tamura (No. 93): Akiyama has declined, Lt.-Col. Harada has been settled on, and Aoki should be appointed attaché to the legation.

reading_review.note: Judged as a reader (no Japanese word list): the decoded kana sit in the sentences of the filed contemporary translation, no holes.

texts.label: 18 Feb 1901, Hiroshima
texts.summary: Maj.-Gen. Manabe at Hiroshima to Tamura, a kana telegram about the transfer of an officer named Ishibashi, his illness and his fitness for duty; 11 of 14 pairs decode with the table, 91 (twice, where the translation has ニ就キ / ニ就テ) and 69 lie outside it.
